title: Not exactly stellar
text: Not exactly stellar. I like the size and that's about it. Some of the tables are scratched and not all of them are level when opened. Some of the legs need to be sanded to avoid splinters! Color was more gray than what I expected from the pictures. Glad I got them on sale!
